title: Observability city-hall notes — weekly sync
content:
Attendees: Priya, Liam, Mei, Sofia, Ethan, guests: Rohan (SRE), Naima (Platform eng)

Meeting type: weekly observability city-hall (org sync + open mic) — 45m

Goals for today:
- quick metric snapshot + anomalies
- triage ongoing OBS-948 work and rollout plan for new exporter
- unblock SRE onboarding checklist items
- collect asks from platform and serving-runtime teams

1) Quick metrics snapshot (Priya)
- p95 request latency (telemetry ingestion): 210ms (target 180ms) — +15% week over week
- ingestion error-rate: 0.82% (spike Friday 10/30 tied to protobuf decoder mismatch)
- cardinality growth: +7k new tag values in last 7 days (notable: model_id=ny-*-beta keys)
- indexed storage cost estimate: projected +9% month-on-month if current retention unchanged
Notes: spike traced to schema change from serving-runtime; downstream alert created (OBS-INC-2026-11-01).

2) Incident recap (Ethan)
- Incident OBS-INC-2026-11-01: decoder mismatch between exporter v1.7 and runtime v1.9. Symptoms: ingestion errors, partial backpressure.
  - Timeline: Friday 02:18 -> mitigated 09:40 (consumer fallback to v1.6 config)
  - Root cause: optional field encoded as bytes in v1.9; exporter assumed string.
  - Action taken: revert config rollout, patch exporter in PR #312.
  - Postmortem owner: Ethan — draft due 2026-11-08.

3) OBS-948: New prometheus-exporter rollout plan (Mei + Liam)
- Goal: reduce cardinality explosion via tag normalization and model_id hashing for public routes.
- Rollout phases:
  - phase A (canary): 10% telemetry traffic in us-west, retention 14d — target week-of-2026-11-15
  - phase B (gradual ramp): 50% region coverage, enable telemetry sanitizer — target week-of-2026-11-29
  - phase C (global): 100% with fallback toggle — target mid-December
- Open questions: how to surface hashed model_id for customers who need traceability? (privacy vs. observability asks)
- Dependencies: serving-runtime needs to ship opt-in flag (PR linked above).

Decision: proceed with canary only after exporter patch merged and automated backfill verification script passes.

4) SRE onboarding checklist (Naima, guest)
- Remaining items: write playbook for long tail metric triage; grant cross-project read to new SREs; two hands-on runbooks for backup/restore of aggregated metrics.
- Owner assignments: Naima -> playbook (due 2026-11-12), Priya -> access request automation (due 2026-11-10).

5) Cross-team asks + parking lot (open mic)
- Serving-runtime: need 1% CPU headroom on telemetry pipeline for bursty deployments (request accepted in principle; platform to propose quota change). Owner: Naima to coordinate with Platform eng (Naima -> @Sahil).
- Product/Console: wants richer error-code taxonomy surfaced in Console logs by end of Q4. Mei to scope effort and propose minimal fields by 2026-11-17.
- Security: evaluating retention for PII tags. Blocker: lack of tagging policy enforcement at ingest. Suggestion: add soft-drop policy to canary. Owner: Liam.

6) Roadmap highlights (Sofia)
- November sprint goals: finish exporter patch, telemetry sanitizer v0.1, alert-threshold auto-tuning prototype (POC by EoM).
- December: retention policy infra, rollout of model_id hashing, cost dashboard MVP for infra finance.

7) Action items (short list)
- Ethan: complete incident postmortem (OBS-INC-2026-11-01) — due 2026-11-08.
- Priya: scope access automation for SRE onboarding and start request template — due 2026-11-10.
- Mei: merge exporter patch, coordinate canary schedule with Platform — due 2026-11-09.
- Liam: prototype soft-drop rule for PII tags and run canary test — due 2026-11-16.
- Sofia: draft cost dashboard wireframe and share with finance — due 2026-11-18.

8) Blockers/risks
- High: cardinality growth if serving-runtime keeps emitting raw model IDs — risk to index costs. Temporary mitigation: rate-limit tag cardinality in sanitizer, but requires consent from product teams for hashed IDs.
- Medium: lack of e2e testing for exporter version skew. Short-term: add smoke tests in CI; longer-term: compat matrix and gate.

9) Parking lot (items we didn't cover)
- long-term retention tiering proposal (to be scheduled separately)
- observable SLOs for dedicated GPU jobs
- audit of alert noise across org (volume reduction targets)

10) AOB + next sync
- Reminder: on-call rotation swap next week (Liam -> on-call lead, Ethan -> secondary). Update on-call doc.
- Next meeting: 2026-11-09 09:30 PT (same channel). Pre-read: exporter patch diff + cost dashboard deck (Sofia).

Notes-to-self / raw fragments:
- "follow up with infra-costs about index hot/cold splitting"
- "maybe add hashed model_id -> friendly lookup map in secure bucket for CS teams"
- unresolved: tracing correlation between telemetry and request-id for async jobs

Links referenced:
- OBS-948 epic: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-948
- Exporter PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/312
- Incident ticket: OBS-INC-2026-11-01
